content.title: Exact current-source universe identity and dependency separation checked
content.text:
Checked code 7501e8c433b9a9fffa2511e2b742c185f2d00985 is pushed on formalize and independently verified. Fresh upstream main is still e53852064d3ef5a2eafec47d754c27504b11de5f.

The actual current-source ref(U)/Mu(U) native request now returns the FULL ORIGINAL U, not merely an unspecified closed value. Its unchanged header takes accepted current source, the SAME source-build heap, an observed stored Mu and a valid domain cache. It derives body execution, raw-row residency, both full probe callbacks and original Mu-key selection internally. It retains the exact complete final machine, validity, semantic heap, coverage, extension, root/U availability, stored equation and stability at formal fuel 13 and every larger value. No product, callback, result or future provider is an input.

Nineteen new public laws across four code increments supply original depth/ordinary/body replay, both same-heap probe packets with one common marker, mapped row/product algebra including duplicates and both cross directions, six stored-dependency path laws, and exact identity. Final public build/strict/import/Audit checks pass: 95,936 aggregate imported theorems; separately 79 explicit reports, 77 standard-axiom and two axiom-free. Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound occur. There are 5,937 source modules and 4,935 direct Audit imports.

Scope: this exact identity starts in the source-build heap. Later valid heaps need a growth version; generic replay requires the prior call's FINAL machine and cannot replace that missing proof. A no-result-gate growth header is frozen, with coverage/semantic preservation implications because structural validity alone does not imply those predicates.

Under existing PendingReferences and Stratified, no positive closed stored dependency path can touch an enumerated fragment. Pure pending cycles and reachable output-history coverage are separate. Existing whole resource closure uses configured narrowing, not literal identity narrowing; metadata erasure cannot bridge this difference. Its sufficiently-large-fuel outcome theorem also does not establish output invariants at all smaller budgets. Exact identity-prefix, whole-CPS and all-fuel targets are preserved as UNCOMPILED headers.

The full original-root finite term under ONE consistent assignment, later generated-type closure, preprocessing/stream/size/rank contracts and compiled Haskell correspondence remain OPEN. No Haskell source, contract, defect or fix was added or established.
